name: GitBook
description: Monitor GitBook documentation spaces and team access for knowledge management compliance

config.setupInstructions:
1. Sign in to GitBook at app.gitbook.com
2. Open User Settings (top-left avatar) > Developer settings > API tokens
3. Create a new API token with read access to your organization
4. Copy the token and paste it below
5. Find your Organization ID in the GitBook URL after signing in (the segment after /o/)
